div.p: Train under a Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer to add one of the world’s most evidence-backed somatic tools to your practice.

img.alt: Isabelle Claus Teixeira — Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer

div.h2: Learning From a Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer
div.p: Isabelle is a Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer — accredited by the TRE™ for All organisation under Dr. David Berceli’s methodology, with the highest level of qualification to certify new TRE™ Providers worldwide. She has trained practitioners globally — across Europe, the US and Asia — bringing 30 years of human development experience and somatic practice to every certification training.

figure.blockquote: “The human body knows how to restore itself. We are trying to educate people to use this mechanism to restore themselves.”
figure.figcaption: — Dr. David Berceli, creator of TRE™

div.p: TRE™ is a body-led series of simple, powerful exercises to release stress, tension and trauma. It safely activates the body’s natural reflex of shaking or vibrating — calming the nervous system and releasing muscular tension. When this process occurs in a safe and controlled environment, the body naturally returns to a balanced state.
Reported benefits of regular TRE™ practice:

div.span: Increased personal energy for work and home
Increased focus, concentration and clearer thinking
Greater calm and emotional composure in stressful situations
Relief from stress-related physical pain, with increased flexibility and mobility

div.p: Learn more about TRE™ worldwide at treglobal.org

header.h2: Why TRE™ Is Worth Certifying In

article.p: TRE™ is backed by over 40 years of research and clinical application across 100+ countries. It has been used with PTSD, trauma, chronic stress and general wellness populations.
Unlike many modalities, TRE™ can be taught to clients for independent practice — making it a high-value, scalable addition to any practitioner’s toolkit.
Works directly with the nervous system through the body’s natural tremor mechanism. No need to narrate or revisit traumatic content.
Applicable in 1:1 coaching, group facilitation, corporate wellness, trauma support, athletic recovery, personal development and more.
TRE™ certification is internationally recognised through TRE™ for All. Certified Providers join a global network of practitioners.
Clients typically experience tangible shifts within 3–4 sessions. The return on investment — for practitioners and clients — is unusually fast.

header.p: Three modules — each a 2-day workshop plus 4 online sessions — take you from personal practice to Certified Global TRE™ Provider.

div.p: 2-day workshop + 4 online personal TRE™ sessions. Explore the stress response (anatomy, neurology and physiology), understand the therapeutic tremor response, and experience TRE™ as a self-practice — including self-regulation, containment and grounding strategies. The first step for anyone keen to pursue the certification path.

div.h3: Module 2 — Teaching TRE™ to One Person
div.p: 2-day workshop + 4 online supervision sessions. Open to those who have completed Module 1 and their personal TRE™ sessions. Deepens Module 1 content, covers Polyvagal theory and basic TRE™ interventions, with hands-on practice teaching TRE™ one-to-one.

2-day workshop + 4 online supervision sessions. Open to those who have completed all learning requirements from Module 2. Deepens Module 2 content and covers the role of fascia, advanced TRE™ interventions and modifications, transference and counter-transference, and experience leading groups of 3+ persons.

On completing all three modules you receive your Global TRE™ Provider certificate — qualified to offer TRE™ to the general public in both individual and group settings, and to competently guide clients through the TRE™ process.

summary.h3: How do I become a Certified TRE™ Provider?

div.p: Complete Modules 1, 2 and 3 of the Global TRE™ Provider Certification. Each module is a 2-day workshop plus 4 online sessions: personal TRE™ sessions in Module 1, supervision in Modules 2 and 3. You also complete the remaining certification requirements, and the certificate is issued by TRE™ for All once you qualify.

summary.h3: How long does the TRE™ certification take?

div.p: The 2027 Singapore cohort runs across three modules: 24–25 April, 3–4 July and 30–31 October 2027, so roughly eight months from first workshop to final module. Online personal and supervision sessions take place between the workshops. Module 1 comes first and can also be booked on its own for personal practice.

The Global TRE™ Provider certificate is issued by TRE™ for All, not by ICF. Module 1 is ICF-accredited and carries 21 ICF CCEs for coaches, and the Growth Package includes ICF credits while the Foundational Package does not. Isabelle can confirm which package suits you before you enrol.
No agenda and no pressure. Tell Isabelle what you are carrying and she will suggest what fits, if anything does.
